release.content: pubdeploy 0.5.3 was released on 2026-11-19 from commit 26a01c7b96bc3a2dad5719e0e3918863ba6fdaf8 with these changes.

rows: The suite's scenarios are Given/When/Then on pubtest's steps: every scenario has a When (TEST-04), and the suite's own copies of pubtest's steps are gone

pubdeploy.testing: the deploy-walk test harness and its sample service as an opt-in pytest plugin (`pubdeploy_testing = true`). Its contract for suites that extend it is the World's hooks: `deploy_world_class`, `secrets_project`, `sample()`, `gcloud_answer(args)`, `patch(monkeypatch)`, `patch_pubsec(monkeypatch)` and `notes`
